failed: accepts login even if a later guest request returns first
accepts verification even if a later guest request returns first
accepts reset even if a later guest request returns first
ignores a guest request started during login but returned after login
cancels a guest payment quote when its order view is abandoned
cause: These fixtures assumed account fetch begins synchronously at the method call. With deferred account code, authentication and cancellation fixtures must await the observable request-start event before starting the explicitly later request or aborting an already-started network request. No business assertions are removed. The new adapter suite separately covers cancellation during module loading with zero network calls.
unhandledRejections: Three synthetic auth responses were assigned to the wrong request because sequence mocks received the guest read before deferred auth code began. Their missing auth result caused assertNoError exceptions.
